card.name: Verbs and drug-name pieces before outcomes
card.fires_on: Fires on a word or word piece just before the main verb or outcome of a clause, such as 'removed', 'allows' or 'return', and on inner pieces of drug names like glucagon, flumazenil and levoleucovorin.

modes.label: Procedure step
modes.description: A passive verb describing a step in a procedure.
